name: Forest View
addressLine: Forest View, Tiptoe Road, Wootton, New Milton

walls.basis: Period red-brick cottage (particulars and photos); solid 9in brick expected, not yet seen. Lime plaster follows (standing full-restoration scope).

note: A candidate property under offer by tender (closing midday 30 Nov 2026), not a purchase. Every dimension is read off the agent's drawing or derived from it; none may size a real job or order a real material until it is measured on site.

orientation.note: The front door faces north onto Tiptoe Road; the rear garden faces south (particulars). The Wootton & Bashley Club is to the west and the lane (Wootton Rough) to the east. Orientation is to be checked with a compass at the viewing.

location.source: Listing map pin (Zoopla, 30 Oct 2026; ra_evidence E63)

plot.note: Schematic. The particulars state about a quarter of an acre with a south-facing rear garden and off-road parking; the rectangle and the house's position in it are traced from the aerial photograph. An overhead line crosses the garden (photos). Replace with the title plan.
